purpose: Bind already existing infrastructure retries to generation and evaluation stages without selecting attempts by algorithm outcome.
rules: A full replacement attempt is admissible only when the scheduled generation ended before an algorithmic candidate outcome with an explicit infrastructure error.
An evaluation-only replacement is admissible only when the scheduled generation completed and the retry evaluated the byte-identical submitted program.
A retry is not selected because it passes; completed algorithm failures remain failures.
Generation and evaluation evidence remain attributed to their actual run IDs.

evidence.scheduled_terminal: generation_completed=false: Candidate execution was blocked by infrastructure failure

evidence.script_identity_evidence: scheduled scripts/generated.sh and retry scripts/generated.sh are byte-identical
scheduled scripts/generated.sh and retry scripts/bootstrap.sh are byte-identical

claim_scope: Retrospective consumed-development measurement repair only; no held-out, leaderboard, or SOTA claim.
